checked_on.description: When the names were last checked

name.description: The domain name as the host stores it

state.description: `here`: the name reaches this instance. `partly`: one address family does, the other does not. `elsewhere`: it answers other addresses. `none`: no A and no AAAA record. `unknown`: a lookup failed or the public address is unknown (see `reason`). `skipped`: a wildcard or regular expression name

via.description: How `here` or `partly` was found: the DNS answer, the provider's record, the target of the provider's CNAME record (`alias`, one level), or the provider's wildcard record

proxied.description: True when the provider record is proxied (Cloudflare)

found.description: The addresses of this family that the name answers (or, with no DNS answer, the provider record's values)

public.description: This instance's public address of the family; null when unknown or not asked

ipv4.description: The IPv4 side: the addresses the name answers and this instance's public address

found.description: The addresses of this family that the name answers (or, with no DNS answer, the provider record's values)

public.description: This instance's public address of the family; null when unknown or not asked

ipv6.description: The IPv6 side: the addresses the name answers and this instance's public address (asked only when the name has AAAA records)

reason.description: A code: `skipped-pattern`, `lookup-timeout`, `lookup-servfail`, `lookup-error`, `public-address-unknown`, `public-ipv6-unknown`, `provider-read-failed`, `provider-read-skipped` (the provider was not read: the request's provider reads were used up or the provider limited the rate; the DNS answer counts), `timeout` (the request's deadline of 60 s ended before this name was checked) or `check-failed` (this name could not be checked)

message.description: The provider's message when `reason` is `provider-read-failed`, with every secret removed

names.description: One result per domain name of the host
